title: Uniform Hölder inequality
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. Their uniform inner product satisfies $\langle f,g\rangle_u\leq \|f\|_{4/3,u}\,\|g\|_{4,u}$, where the norms are the uniform $L^{4/3}$ and $L^4$ norms.
